title: LLM ToolHook Request
description: Request body sent to the llm verb's toolHook when the LLM invokes a function/tool during a conversation.

tool_call_id.description: Unique identifier for this tool call, echoed back by the caller when responding.

name.description: Name of the tool/function being invoked.

args.description: Parsed arguments object for the tool call. Note: the llm verb names this field 'args', not 'arguments' (unlike the agent verb).
